args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

src/money.py quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP but the docstring and
tests/test_money.py expect ROUND_HALF_EVEN. This caused the nightly
build to fail. Switch the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP` while its docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- This caused the nightly build to fail `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.675` must round to `2.68`, but `2.665` must round to `2.66`).
- Fix: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986`: **passed** (includes `tests/test_money.py`).

Fixes the nightly build failure in time for today's release.
